name: org.machanism.machai:genai-client
description: GenAI Client is a Java library for integrating Machai applications with generative AI platforms through a consistent provider abstraction. It provides provider resolution, prompt and instruction handling, OpenAI and Anthropic provider adapters, EPAM CodeMie authentication and delegation, embedding generation, token usage tracking, Java ServiceLoader-based function tool registration, prompt and resource annotations, MCP server integration, optional web search configuration, and deterministic host-side YAML tool execution. It is intended for AI-powered Java applications, semantic search workflows, automated content generation, intelligent project assembly, provider-independent prompt workflows, local tool orchestration, and integrations that need a common org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai lifecycle across multiple AI backends.

usageContext: Use when a Java application needs a common GenAI abstraction for OpenAI-compatible APIs, Anthropic Claude, EPAM CodeMie, local function tools, no-op testing providers, embeddings, usage statistics, prompt registration, and MCP or web-search-enabled model calls.

Use for building AI-enabled Maven or Java applications that need provider-independent prompt execution, tool calling, semantic search embeddings, and runtime configuration through org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator.

Use for registering Java methods annotated with org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.Tool, org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.Prompt, org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.Resource, and org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.Param as AI-accessible capabilities.

constructors.description: Creates and initializes a generative AI provider from a provider/model string such as OpenAI:gpt-4o-mini, Anthropic:claude-3-5-sonnet, CodeMie:gpt-4o-mini, Tools:yaml, or None:log. If the provider segment is a fully qualified class name it is loaded directly; otherwise the manager resolves org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.impl.{Provider}Provider and initializes it with the model portion and configurator.

examples.description: Resolves and uses an OpenAI-backed provider through the common Genai contract. In a real application the Configurator should provide OPENAI_API_KEY and any optional provider settings.

constructors.description: Creates and initializes an embedding provider from a provider/model string. The returned object implements org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.EmbeddingProvider and can produce java.util.List<java.lang.Double> vectors for semantic search and similarity workflows.

examples.description: Resolves an embedding provider and requests an embedding vector. Configure the backing provider credentials, such as OPENAI_API_KEY for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, in the Configurator.

constructors.description: Creates an OpenAI-backed provider that adapts the Machai Genai API to the OpenAI Java SDK Responses API and embedding API. Initialize it with a model and Configurator before calling prompt, addTools, perform, or embedding.

examples.description: Directly constructs the OpenAI provider. The Configurator should contain OPENAI_API_KEY and may contain OPENAI_BASE_URL, GENAI_TIMEOUT, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, MAX_TOOL_CALLS, WebSearchTool.*, and MCP.* settings.

constructors.description: Creates an Anthropic-backed provider that adapts Machai Genai to Anthropic Claude Beta Messages. It supports prompts, instructions, function tools, web search, MCP forwarding, prompt-cache control, and usage tracking.

examples.description: Directly constructs an Anthropic Claude provider. The Configurator should provide ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and may provide ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, GENAI_TIMEOUT, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, MAX_TOOL_CALLS, cacheThreshold, WebSearchTool.*, and MCP.* settings.

features.name: Genai lifecycle
features.description: Provides a common lifecycle for conversational and tool-enabled AI providers: init, instructions, prompt, addTools, addPrompts, addResources, setProjectDir, setErrorHandling, setEnabledTools, perform, and clear. Implementations may preserve session state between calls and should be reset with clear when reusing an instance for a new request.

examples.description: Demonstrates provider-independent usage through the Genai interface. Swap None:log for OpenAI:gpt-4o-mini, Anthropic:claude-3-5-sonnet, CodeMie:gpt model, or Tools:yaml without changing the call sequence.

features.name: OpenAI Responses and Embeddings provider
features.description: OpenAIProvider adapts OpenAI-compatible Responses and Embeddings APIs to Machai. It supports conversational prompting, file inputs, iterative function-tool calls, MCP tools, web search, usage capture, custom OPENAI_BASE_URL endpoints, and embedding vectors.

examples.description: Uses OpenAIProvider for embeddings. Configure OPENAI_API_KEY before running. Use OPENAI_BASE_URL for OpenAI-compatible services.

features.name: CodeMie delegated provider
features.description: CodeMieProvider authenticates against an OAuth 2.0 token endpoint with password grant or client credentials, obtains an access token, configures downstream OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY, and delegates gpt, gemini, embedding, and titan embedding models to OpenAIProvider or claude models to AnthropicProvider.

examples.snippet: org.machanism.machanism.machai.ai.provider.impl.CodeMieProvider provider;
examples.description: Do not use this malformed snippet; use the next example for practical invocation.
Runs a CodeMie-backed chat model. Configure GENAI_USERNAME, GENAI_PASSWORD, and optionally AUTH_URL in the Configurator or runtime configuration.

features.name: FunctionTools SPI and annotations
features.description: Discovers org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools implementations with Java ServiceLoader, filters them by org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.SupportedFor, and registers annotated @Tool methods and @Prompt methods with a Genai provider. Parameter metadata is supplied with @Param, resources with @Resource, and executable callbacks through ToolFunction.

examples.description: Installs all compatible ServiceLoader-discovered FunctionTools into a provider before running prompts that may invoke those tools.

features.name: Usage statistics
features.signature: public static void org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.UsageStatistics.addUsage(java.lang.String modelId, org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.Usage usage)
features.description: Records immutable token usage values grouped by model identifier. Usage contains input token, cached input token, and output token counts. UsageStatistics exposes methods to add entries, query per-model entries, get all model usage, and log summaries.

examples.description: Records and retrieves usage metrics for operational diagnostics or cost reporting.

features.name: ToolsProvider YAML execution
features.description: ToolsProvider executes locally registered function tools directly from structured YAML input when initialized with the yaml model. It is useful for deterministic host-side orchestration and tool-only workflows where no external model call is desired.

examples.description: Invokes a registered local tool from a YAML descriptor. Register tools with provider.addTools or FunctionToolsLoader before calling perform.

customizations.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools
customizations.description: Implement this SPI to package Java methods as host-managed AI tools, prompts, or resources. Public methods annotated with @Tool, @Prompt, and @Resource are discovered and registered by providers or FunctionToolsLoader.

examples.description: Creates a custom FunctionTools bundle. Register the fully qualified implementation name in META-INF/services/org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools and apply it with FunctionToolsLoader.

customizations.name: Configuration properties
customizations.description: Provider behavior is customized through Configurator keys such as OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, GENAI_TIMEOUT, MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, MAX_TOOL_CALLS, WebSearchTool.type, WebSearchTool.city, WebSearchTool.country, WebSearchTool.region, MCP.url, MCP.name, MCP.authorization, MCP.description, GENAI_USERNAME, GENAI_PASSWORD, and AUTH_URL for CodeMie.

examples.snippet:
OPENAI_API_KEY=your-openai-key
OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.openai.com/v1
WebSearchTool.type=default
MCP.url=https://example.org/mcp
MCP.name=Project MCP
MCP.authorization=Bearer token
examples.description: Example runtime configuration enabling OpenAI, web search, and an MCP server. Store secrets outside source control and provide them through your Configurator implementation or environment-backed configuration.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.Genai
studs.description: Primary provider contract for generative AI integrations. It defines initialization, prompt collection, instructions, execution, cleanup, tool registration, prompt registration, resource registration, project directory propagation, error handling, and enabled tool filtering.

examples.description: Uses the Genai interface as the boundary instead of depending on a provider-specific SDK.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.EmbeddingProvider
studs.description: Boundary contract for providers that can initialize with a model and Configurator and generate embedding vectors for text. Implementations include OpenAIProvider and CodeMieProvider.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.EmbeddingProvider provider = org.machanism.machai.ai.manager.GenaiProviderManager.getEmbeddingProvider("OpenAI:text-embedding-3-small", null);
java.util.List<java.lang.Double> vector = provider.embedding("semantic search document", 1536L);
examples.description: Uses the embedding boundary for semantic indexing or similarity matching.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.provider.AbstractAIProvider
studs.description: Reusable base implementation for concrete Genai providers. It centralizes configuration handling, request input logging, tool and prompt registration, MCP and web search bootstrap, safe tool invocation, project directory propagation, timeout support, and error handling behavior.

examples.description: Shows the extension point for creating a custom provider while reusing common AbstractAIProvider behavior.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.ToolFunction
studs.description: Functional interface representing a callable tool handler. It receives structured com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode parameters and optional runtime context objects such as java.io.File and Configurator, then returns a serializable result.

examples.snippet: org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.ToolFunction function = (com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode params, java.lang.Object... context) -> params.path("name").asText();
examples.description: Defines a simple ToolFunction lambda that reads a JSON parameter.

steps: Add the dependency to your Maven pom.xml.
Provide provider credentials through your Configurator implementation or environment-backed configuration.
Resolve a provider with GenaiProviderManager and call the common Genai lifecycle.
examples.snippet:
<dependency>
  <groupId>org.machanism.machai</groupId>
  <artifactId>genai-client</artifactId>
  <version>1.3.1</version>
</dependency>

examples.title: Configure and run an OpenAI-compatible chat provider

examples.title: Create and register a custom Java function tool
steps: Annotate public methods with org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.Tool and parameters with org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.Param.
Create src/main/resources/META-INF/services/org.machanism.machai.ai.tools.FunctionTools containing the fully qualified implementation class name.
